articles.headline: Zero to hero: Socceroos' Robertson scores stunning match-winner after own goal
articles.description: Socceroos midfielder Alex Robertson has been feted as "Kangaroo" by his Cardiff City teammates after he bounced back from scoring an own goal to lash home a sensational, stoppage-time winner in one of the Championship side's greatest comebacks.

articles.headline: Wrexham boss on Ryan Reynolds, Rob Mac: 'Uplifting' when they come to watch
articles.description: Wrexham couldn't serve up a blockbuster for owners Ryan Reynolds and Rob Mac but manager Phil Parkinson praised the Hollywood duo's input into a point that kept Wolves off the Championship summit.

images.name: Wrexham co-owners Ryan Reynolds [1296x729]
images.alt: Wrexham co-owners Ryan Reynolds (right) and Rob Mac (centre) speaks Wrexham manager Phil Parkinson (left) following the Sky Bet Championship match at the Racecourse Ground, Wrexham. Picture date: Saturday November 7, 2026.
images.credit: Cody Froggatt/PA Images via Getty Images

articles.headline: Ryan Reynolds, Rob Mac watch on as Wrexham deny Wolves top spot with draw
articles.description: Lewis O'Brien's first goal of the season earned Wrexham a 1-1 draw and prevented Wolves going top of the Championship, under the watching eye of Ryan Reynolds and Rob Mac.

images.name: Reynolds and Rob Mac [1296x729]
images.caption: Rob Reynolds and Rob Mac watched the game on Saturday.
images.alt: Wrexham co-owners Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney known as Rob Mac (behind) during the Sky Bet Championship match at the Racecourse Ground, Wrexham. Picture date: Saturday November 7, 2026.
images.credit: Cody Froggatt/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Lewis O'Brien [1296x729]
images.caption: Lewis O'Brien scored the equaliser for Wrexham against Wolves.
images.alt: Wrexham's Lewis O'Brien (third from left) celebrates scoring their side's first goal of the game during the Sky Bet Championship match at the Racecourse Ground, Wrexham. Picture date: Saturday November 7, 2026.
images.credit: Cody Froggatt/PA Images via Getty Images

articles.headline: Wrexham joy at big win dented by losing striker Sam Smith for season
articles.description: Wrexham's morale-boosting win over Championship leaders Middlesbrough was partially overshadowed by confirmation that striker Sam Smith will miss the rest of the season.
